protocol_mismatch.title: F.R.I.D.A.Y. agent protocol mismatch
protocol_mismatch.description: The F.R.I.D.A.Y. agent speaks a protocol version this integration does not support. Update the integration or the agent so both use the same protocol.

user.title: F.R.I.D.A.Y.
user.description: Add the F.R.I.D.A.Y. integration. Add the server and satellites afterwards as devices of this entry.

zeroconf_confirm.title: F.R.I.D.A.Y. satellite found
zeroconf_confirm.description: Satellite at {host}. Enter its local-port password and, optionally, the area.

data_description.token: The agent token from the server (never shared outside Home Assistant).
data_description.proxmox_token_secret: Leave blank to keep the stored value. The Reboot VM button appears only when all Proxmox fields are filled.

data_description.token: Leave blank to keep the stored token.
data_description.proxmox_token_secret: Leave blank to keep the stored value. The Reboot VM button appears only when all Proxmox fields are filled.

data_description.token: The satellite's local-port password (never shared outside Home Assistant).
Leave blank to keep the stored token.

wifi.title: Change Wi-Fi
wifi.description: The satellite joins the new network; if it does not answer within a minute, it goes back to the previous one. The password is not stored.

room_sensors.title: Room sensors
room_sensors.description: Where the room temperature and humidity come from. Leave a source empty to keep that sensor unavailable. The entity is used only with the Home Assistant entity source.

abort.wifi_changed: Wi-Fi change started; the result appears in the logbook and in the Wi-Fi change sensor.

error.wifi_failed: The new network did not work (or the satellite is offline); the previous one was kept.

set_wifi.name: Set Wi-Fi
set_wifi.description: Starts a Wi-Fi change on a satellite. It rolls back by itself if the new network does not work; the outcome appears in the logbook and in the Wi-Fi change sensor.

init.title: Models
init.description: Model used by each role. Voice and Lucid apply from the next conversation or run; the brain restarts F.R.I.D.A.Y. only when no conversation is open.

embeddings_confirm.title: Change embeddings model
embeddings_confirm.description: Switching to {model} re-indexes the memory. Estimate: {estimate}.

abort.server_unavailable: The F.R.I.D.A.Y. server is not connected.
abort.embeddings_unavailable: The server cannot change the embeddings model yet.
